object.attr: stakeholder: a rules file's when element names attributes as XML attribute names, which can't start with a digit or a hyphen, so such an attribute can't be tested by a rule. Decided on 2026-11-10. Tools accept a digit or hyphen first today (USAGE.md); an existing name that breaks this is a validation error (MELLON-CHECK-SRS).
object.description: An attribute definition's name shall start with one of A–Z, a–z and underscore, followed by zero or more of A–Z, a–z, 0–9, hyphen and underscore.
